snippet.title: SEED | Gameplay Trailer | Mary, Peter and Gunter
snippet.description:
What happens when players control everything? Welcome to SEED.

This gameplay trailer follows the intersecting lives of Mary, Peter, and Gunther, three Seedlings surviving, thriving and conspiring on the planet Avesta. Because there are NO NPCs in SEED, the drama you see is completely unscripted, organic, and driven entirely by the community.
Collaborate, govern, trade, or betray. The simulation runs continuously 24/7, meaning the world never sleeps, and every choice carries permanent consequences.

Will your society thrive, or will it crumble? It’s all up to you. 

🌍 Join US: https://seed.game/wishlist
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/seedgame
